+/*
+ * @test
+ * @bug 8397176
+ * @summary VerifyError when running compiled varargs method references with
+ *          intersection type receivers.
+ * @compile MethodReferenceVarargsIntersectionTest.java
+ * @run main MethodReferenceVarargsIntersectionTest
+ */
+
+public class MethodReferenceVarargsIntersectionTest {
+
+    static class A {}
+
+    interface B {
+        void m(String... args);
+    }
+
+    static class C extends A implements B {
+        @Override
+        public void m(String... args) {}
+    }
+
+    public static void main(String... args) {
+        var i = (A & B) new C();
+        ((Runnable) i::m).run();
+    }
+}
